shortDescription: Adds, modifies, or removes a Proxmox realm.

options.name: acr_values
options.description: Specifies the Authentication Context Class Reference values that theAuthorization Server is being requested to use for the Auth Request.

options.name: autocreate
options.description: Automatically create users if they do not exist.

options.name: base_dn
options.description: LDAP base domain name. Required when type is 'ldap'.

options.name: bind_dn
options.description: LDAP bind domain name.

options.name: capath
options.description: Path to the CA certificate store.

options.name: case_sensitive
options.description: Username is case-sensitive.

options.name: cert
options.description: Path to the client certificate.

options.name: certkey
options.description: Path to the client certificate key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: OpenID Client ID. Required when type is 'openid'.

options.name: client_key
options.description: OpenID Client Key.

options.name: comment
options.description: Optionally sets the comment field.

options.name: default
options.description: Use this as default realm.

options.name: domain
options.description: AD domain name. Required when type is 'ad'.

options.name: filter
options.description: LDAP filter for user sync.

options.name: group_classes
options.description: The objectclasses for groups.

options.name: group_dn
options.description: LDAP base domain name for group sync. If not set, the base_dn will be used.

options.name: group_filter
options.description: LDAP filter for group sync.

options.name: group_name_attr
options.description: LDAP attribute representing a groups name. If not set or found, the first value of the DN will be used as name.

options.name: issuer_url
options.description: OpenID Issuer URL. Required when type is 'openid'.

options.name: mode
options.description: LDAP protocol mode.

options.name: name
options.description: The realm name.

options.name: password
options.description: LDAP bind password. Will be stored in /etc/pve/priv/realm/<REALM>.pw.

options.name: port
options.description: Server port.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Specifies whether the Authorization Server prompts the End-User for reauthentication and consent. (?:none|login|consent|select_account|\S+)

options.name: scopes
options.description: B(Warning:) not to be confused with parameter I(scope) (singular). Specifies the scopes (user details) that should be authorized and returned, for example email or profile.

options.name: secure
options.description: Use ssl.

options.name: server1
options.description: Server IP address (or DNS name). Required when type is 'ad' or 'ldap'.

options.name: server2
options.description: Fallback Server IP address (or DNS name).

options.name: sslversion
options.description: LDAPS TLS/SSL version. It's not recommended to use version older than 1.2!

options.name: state
options.description: Specify if the realm should exist (present) or absent.

options.name: sync
options.description: For a sync command to automatically sync users and groups for LDAP-based realms (LDAP & Microsoft Active Directory only) This requires the correct fields to be set. Please refer to the syncing sections of `pveum man page <https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/pveum.1.html>`__.

options.name: sync_options
options.description: Optional fields for when I(sync) is true

options.name: type
options.description: Realm type.

options.name: user_attr
options.description: LDAP user attribute name. Required when type is 'ldap'.

options.name: user_classes
options.description: The objectclasses for users. (default = C(inetorgperson, posixaccount, person, user))

options.name: username_claim
options.description: OpenID claim used to generate the unique username.

options.name: verify
options.description: Verify the server’s SSL certificate.
